blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Point-supervised temporal action localization (PTAL) aims to recognize and localize action instances in untrimmed videos using only point-level annotations. Existing pseudo-label-based methods have made substantial progress in PTAL. However, confidence-based initialization can overlook well-localized proposals. Meanwhile, existing methods either keep pseudo-labels fixed during detector training or update them without fully exploiting alternative boundary evidence from the original proposal pool. These limitations constrain supervision quality, thereby hindering detection performance. To learn high-quality pseudo-labels, we propose a framework that integrates prior-guided initialization with consensus-guided refinement during detector training. Our framework comprises two modules: Prior-Guided Initialization (PGI) and Consensus-Guided Refinement (CGR). PGI combines proposal confidence with point-derived priors to establish instance-specific reliability for initial pseudo-label selection and candidate retention. CGR continually uses the retained original candidates to construct boundary targets, combining their consensus with evolving detector predictions to refine pseudo-labels throughout training. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive detection performance compared with existing methods. In particular, our method achieves 68.5\% average mAP over tIoU thresholds 0.1--0.7 on THUMOS14, surpassing PseR by 3.7 percentage points. Code is available at https://github.com/zhenyingfang/LHQP
blocks.zh: 由点监督的时间动作本地化(PTAL)旨在仅用点级说明来识别和本地化无线视频中的动作实例. 现有的以假标签为基础的方法在PTAL中已取得重大进展. 然而,基于信任的初始化可以忽略地方化的建议。 与此同时,现有方法要么在探测器训练期间固定假标签,要么在不充分利用原提案库的替代边界证据的情况下加以更新。 这些限制限制了监督质量,从而阻碍了检测工作。 为了学习高质量的伪标签,我们提出了一个框架,在探测器培训中将事先指导的初始化与协商一致指导的完善结合起来。 我们的框架包括两个单元:先入为主的初始化(PGI)和 " 共识指导 " 完善(CGR)。 PGI将提案置信度与出点前缀相结合,以确定初始伪标签选择和候选人保留的具体实例可靠性. CGR继续使用所保留的原始候选人构建边界目标,将其共识同不断演变的探测器预测结合起来,在整个培训中完善伪标签。 对四项基准的实验表明,与现有方法相比,我们的方法实现了竞争性检测。 特别是,在THUMOS14上,我们的方法在tIoU阈值上实现了68.5-%的平均mAP,超过了0.1-0.7,超过了PseR3.7个百分点. 代码见https://github.com/zhenyingfang/LHQP

blocks.en: Temporal action localization (TAL) aims to recognize action instances and determine their temporal boundaries in untrimmed videos [ 47 , 7 ] , supporting applications such as visual question answering [ 17 ] , video summarization [ 16 ] , and highlight detection [ 39 ] . Fully supervised methods [ 35 , 8 , 37 ] have achieved impressive performance, but require precise temporal boundaries for individual action instances, which are costly and labor-intensive to annotate. This annotation burden has motivated weakly supervised temporal action localization (WTAL) [ 32 , 33 ] , which learns from video-level category labels. Without instance-level temporal cues, however, recovering complete action intervals remains difficult, leaving a substantial performance gap to fully supervised methods.
blocks.zh: Temperal Action localization (TAL) 旨在识别动作实例,并确定其在无线视频中的时间界限[47,7],支持视觉问题回答[17],视频总结[16]等应用,并突出检测[39]. 充分监督的方法[35、8、37]取得了令人印象深刻的业绩,但需要为个别行动规定准确的时间界限,而这些行动是代价高昂的,对注释来说是劳力密集型的。 这种注解负担激发了对时间动作局部化(WTAL)的弱监督(WTAL)[32,33],从视频级别标签中学习. 然而,如果没有实例层面的时间提示,恢复完整的行动间隔仍然困难重重,给充分监督的方法留下了巨大的性能差距。

blocks.en: To balance detection performance and annotation cost, point-supervised temporal action localization (PTAL) has been proposed as an alternative supervision setting. PTAL requires only one annotated frame and its category per action instance. Early methods [ 27 , 15 , 44 ] follow a localization-by-classification paradigm, inferring action intervals from Class Activation Sequences (CAS) learned under point supervision. However, CAS are learned using classification objectives, and the mismatch between classification and localization limits the detection performance of these methods [ 10 ] . To provide explicit localization supervision, pseudo-label-based methods construct temporal pseudo-labels to train localization models [ 48 , 5 , 6 ] . POTLoc [ 36 ] generates pseudo-labels using point-compatible proposals and proposal statistics. PseR [ 6 ] propagates seed proposals through temporal perturbations and refines pseudo-labels using proposal selection and ranking.
blocks.zh: 为了平衡检测的性能和注释成本,建议将点监督的时间动作本地化(PTAL)作为替代监督设置. PTAL只需要一个附加说明的框架及其每个行动实例的类别。 早期的方法[27,15,44]遵循一个逐个分类的本地化范式,推断出在点监督下学习的类激活序列(CAS)的动作间隔. 然而,CAS使用分类目标来学习,分类和本地化的不匹配限制了这些方法的检测性能[10]. 为了提供明确的本地化监督,基于伪标签的方法构建了时间伪标签,以训练本地化模型[48, 5, 6]. POTLoc [36] 利用点相兼容的建议书和建议书统计生成伪标签. PseR [6]通过时间扰动传播种子建议书,并利用建议书的选择和排名来完善伪标签.

blocks.en: Despite this progress, pseudo-label quality remains constrained at both initialization and subsequent detector training. First, proposal confidence does not necessarily reflect localization quality for the annotated instance. Fig. 1 (a) reveals a substantial gap between highest-confidence and oracle selection from the same point-compatible candidate pool, showing that well-localized proposals can be overlooked during initialization. Second, pseudo-labels either remain fixed during detector training or evolve without fully exploiting alternative boundaries from the original pool. Fixed labels cannot incorporate new localization evidence, while reducing the pool to pseudo-label intervals limits direct access to individual original alternatives during later updates. Together, these limitations restrict supervision quality and the detector’s ability to learn accurate action boundaries.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这一进展,但在初始化和随后的探测器培训中,伪标签的质量仍然受到限制。 首先,提案的信心不一定反映附加说明的实例的本地化质量。 图1(a)显示,最高信任度与从同一点匹配的候选人库中挑选甲骨文之间存在很大差距,显示在初始化期间,当地化的提议可能被忽略。 其次,假标签要么在探测器训练期间固定下来,要么在未充分利用原池的替代边界的情况下演变。 固定标签不能包含新的本地化证据,同时将池缩小为伪标签间隔限制在以后更新时直接访问单个原始替代品. 这些限制共同限制了监督质量和探测器学习准确行动界限的能力。

blocks.en: We address these limitations by learning high-quality pseudo-labels through reliable initialization and iterative boundary refinement. Our framework comprises two modules: Prior-Guided Initialization (PGI) and Consensus-Guided Refinement (CGR). PGI assesses the reliability of candidate proposals associated with each annotated point by combining confidence, geometric, and conflict priors. Using these reliability scores, PGI selects initial pseudo-labels while retaining alternative candidates with their original boundaries and reliability scores to support subsequent pseudo-label evolution.
blocks.zh: 我们通过可靠的初始化和迭代边界的完善来学习高质量的伪标签来克服这些局限性。 我们的框架包括两个单元:事先指导的初始化和协商一致指导的完善。 PGI将信任、几何和冲突前述因素结合起来,评估与每个注解点有关的候选提案的可靠性。 PGI使用这些可靠性分数,选择初始伪标签,同时保留具有原始边界和可靠性分数的替代候选人,支持随后的伪标签演变.

blocks.en: CGR reuses the candidates retained by PGI to progressively refine pseudo-label boundaries during detector training. At each update round, it combines a reliability-weighted consensus of these candidates with current detector predictions to construct boundary targets, which guide consistency-controlled pseudo-label updates. This allows alternative boundaries beyond the initial pseudo-label to provide supporting evidence throughout training. As shown in Fig. 1 (b), PGI+CGR increases the fraction of pseudo-labels with tIoU ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7 over fixed PGI supervision by 7.3 and 0.9 percentage points on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet1.3, respectively.
blocks.zh: CGR重新利用PGI保留的候选人,在探测器训练期间逐步完善伪标签界限. 在每一轮更新中,它将这些候选人的可靠性加权共识与目前的探测器预测结合起来,以构建边界目标,指导一致性控制的伪标签更新. 这样,除了最初的假标签之外,还可以在培训期间提供辅助证据。 如图1(b)所示,PGI+CGR在THUMOS14和ActivityNet1.3上分别比PGI的固定监督增加了7.3和0.9个百分点,伪标签为tIoU ^ 0.7\geq 0.7。

blocks.en: Experiments on THUMOS14, ActivityNet1.3, GTEA, and BEOID demonstrate competitive detection performance compared with existing methods. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We introduce PGI to assess candidate reliability using point annotations, enabling instance-aware pseudo-label initialization while retaining alternative boundary hypotheses for subsequent evolution. • We introduce CGR to combine consensus from retained original candidates with evolving detector predictions for boundary target construction, allowing alternative boundary evidence to continually support pseudo-label refinement. • Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate improved pseudo-label quality and competitive detection performance, while ablation studies validate the complementary roles of PGI and CGR.
blocks.zh: THUMOS14号的实验,活动 Net1.3、GTEA和BEOID显示出与现有方法相比的竞争性检测性能。 • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们采用PGI, 使用点标来评估候选的可靠性, 使实例意识到伪标签初始化,同时保留可供以后演变使用的替代边界假设。 我们引入了CGR,将保留原有候选人的共识与不断演变的边界目标建造探测器预测结合起来,允许替代边界证据不断支持改进伪标签。 • 对四项基准进行的广泛试验显示,伪标签质量和竞争性检测性能有所改善,而消毒研究则验证了PGI和CGR的互补作用。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate improved pseudo-label quality and competitive detection performance, while ablation studies validate the complementary roles of PGI and CGR.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Temporal Action Localization
blocks.zh: 2.1 临时行动本地化

blocks.en: Fully supervised temporal action localization (TAL) relies on instance-level category labels and precise temporal boundary annotations. Representative detectors follow anchor-based, anchor-free, hybrid, or query-based designs. Anchor-based methods associate predictions with predefined temporal windows. Within anchor-based designs, one-stage detectors [ 22 ] jointly predict action categories and boundary offsets, while two-stage detectors [ 40 ] first generate temporal proposals and subsequently refine and classify them. Temporal anchors provide useful duration priors, but their predefined scales can restrict flexibility when action durations vary substantially [ 41 ] . To alleviate these restrictions, anchor-free methods [ 47 , 35 , 1 , 11 ] eliminate manually designed temporal anchors. They predict action categories and distances to temporal boundaries directly at temporal locations. Hybrid approaches [ 8 , 41 ] further integrate anchor-based and anchor-free branches to exploit their complementary strengths. Across these dense prediction designs, post-processing such as non-maximum suppression is typically used to remove duplicate detections. Query-based detectors [ 25 , 14 ] simplify this pipeline by formulating TAL as set prediction with learnable action queries and one-to-one matching. Despite these architectural advances, training still relies on costly temporal boundary annotations, motivating localization under weaker supervision.
blocks.zh: 充分监督的时间动作本地化(TAL)依赖于实例级分类标签和精确的时间边界说明. 代表性探测器遵循基于锚,无锚,混合,或基于查询的设计. 基于锁定的方法将预测与预定义的时间窗口联系起来. 在基于锚的设计中,单级探测器[22]联合预测动作类别和边界抵消,而双级探测器[40]首先生成时间建议,随后对其进行精细和分类. 临时锚点提供了有用的持续时间,但如果行动持续时间差别很大[41],其预先确定的尺度会限制灵活性。 为了减轻这些限制,无锚方法[47,35,1,11]取消了人工设计的时间锚. 它们预测行动类别和时间界限直接位于时间位置的距离。 混合方法[8,41]进一步整合了基于锚和无锚的分支,以利用其互补优势. 在这些密集的预测设计中,非最大压制等后处理通常用于消除重复检测. 基于查询的探测器[25,14]简化了这一管道,将TAL作为成套预测,并附有可学习的动作查询和一对一的匹配. 尽管这些建筑进步,培训仍然依靠昂贵的时间界限说明,促使在较弱的监督下就地化。

blocks.en: 2.2 Weakly-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
blocks.zh: 2.2 地方化

blocks.en: Weakly supervised temporal action localization (WTAL) reduces annotation costs by learning from video-level category labels without temporal boundary annotations [ 43 , 18 , 32 ] . A common approach follows the localization-by-classification paradigm [ 43 , 42 , 34 ] , which trains a classifier to estimate snippet-level class scores and derives action intervals by thresholding the resulting activation sequences. However, classification objectives tend to emphasize the most discriminative snippets, while less distinctive parts of an action may receive weak responses. This discrepancy makes it difficult to recover complete action instances from classification scores alone.
blocks.zh: 弱监督的时间动作本地化(WTAL)通过从没有时间界限说明的视频级别分类标签中学习来降低注释成本[43,18,32]. 一个共同的方法遵循了逐个分类的本地化范式[43,42,34],该范式训练一个分类员来估计片段级的分数,并通过阈值设定由此产生的激活序列来得出动作间隔. 然而,分类目标往往强调最具歧视性的片段,而行动中不太突出的部分可能得到弱的答复。 这种差异使得仅从分类分数中很难收回完整的行动实例。

blocks.en: Pseudo-label-based methods [ 33 , 46 , 26 , 20 ] address this discrepancy by generating temporal pseudo-labels to supervise an additional localization model, enabling direct optimization of temporal boundaries. Despite their progress, video-level labels provide no explicit indication of instance positions, making reliable pseudo-label construction challenging and leaving a performance gap relative to fully supervised methods. Point annotations offer sparse temporal cues for individual instances. Our method uses these cues to establish instance-specific proposal reliability for initial pseudo-label construction and to preserve relevant original boundary hypotheses for subsequent label evolution.
blocks.zh: 基于Pseudo-label的方法[33,46,26,20]通过生成时间伪标签来监督额外的本地化模型来解决这一差异,从而能够直接优化时间界限. 尽管取得了进步,但视频级别的标签没有明确说明实例位置,使得可靠的假标签构建工作具有挑战性,并留下了与完全监督的方法相比的性能差距. 要点说明为个别情况提供了短暂的时间提示。 我们的方法利用这些提示来确定初始伪标签构建的针对实例的建议书可靠性,并保存相关的原始边界假说,用于后续标签演化.

blocks.en: 2.3 Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
blocks.zh: 2.3 重点监督的临时性行动

blocks.en: Point-supervised temporal action localization (PTAL) requires only a single annotated frame and its category for each action instance [ 27 ] . One line of research expands sparse point supervision and strengthens action representations. Early localization-by-classification methods include SF-Net [ 27 ] , which mines labels for neighboring snippets, and LACP [ 15 ] , which learns action completeness through pseudo-label sequence search. CRRC-Net [ 10 ] improves representation compactness and snippet-label reliability, while proposal-level learning [ 44 ] generates dense supervision through clustering. Related efforts model temporal structure through auxiliary understanding tasks [ 29 ] or enrich visual representations with refined textual descriptions [ 30 ] .
blocks.zh: 由点监督的时间行动本地化(PTAL)只需要单个附加说明的框架,以及每个行动实例的类别[27]. 研究的一线扩大了零星点监督,加强了行动表述. 早期的本地化逐级分类方法包括SF-Net [27],为邻居片段贴上地雷标签,LACP [15],通过伪标签序列搜索学习动作完整性. CRRC-Net [10] 改进了表示紧凑性和片段标签可靠性,而建议级学习 [44] 通过集群产生密集的监管. 相关努力通过辅助理解任务模拟时间结构[29]或用精细的文字描述丰富视觉表现[30].

blocks.en: A complementary line of research constructs temporal pseudo-labels for explicit localization learning [ 5 , 48 , 6 , 36 , 49 , 23 ] . These methods infer interval supervision from sparse annotations, enabling direct optimization of temporal boundaries. Among closely related approaches, POTLoc [ 36 ] refines point-supervised proposals into pseudo-labels for self-training. NoCo [ 49 ] introduces online label revision through a teacher–student framework and is also evaluated under point supervision.
blocks.zh: 辅助研究线为明确本地化学习构建了时间伪标签[5,48,6,36,49,23]. 这些方法推断出间隔监督从零散的说明,从而能够直接优化时间界限。 在密切相关的办法中,POTLoc[36]将有点监督的建议改进为自我培训的伪标签。 NoCo[49]通过教师-学生框架引入在线标签修改,并接受点评。

blocks.en: Building on advances in pseudo-label generation and online correction, we focus on the continued use of original proposal evidence after initialization. Our framework uses point-derived reliability to connect initial pseudo-label selection with candidate retention, then dynamically reweights the retained boundary hypotheses using evolving detector predictions. The original boundaries remain fixed, while their contributions to supervision evolve, allowing candidates beyond the initially selected interval to support subsequent updates.
blocks.zh: 在伪标签生成和在线更正方面的进展基础上,我们侧重于在初始化后继续使用原提案证据。 我们的框架利用点衍生的可靠性,将初始的伪标签选择与候选人保留联系起来,然后利用不断发展的探测器预测,动态地重新权衡保留的边界假设。 原有的界限保持不变,而他们对监督的贡献也在演变,使得超过最初选定的间隔期的候选人能够支持随后的更新.

blocks.en: We train the detector with PGI-initialized pseudo-labels and annotated categories, replacing the temporal supervision with refined pseudo-labels after each CGR update. The retained original proposals and their reliability scores remain fixed throughout training and support boundary target construction at subsequent updates.
blocks.zh: 我们用PGI初始化的伪标签和附加说明的类别来训练探测器,每次更新CGR后用精细的伪标签来取代时间监督. 保留原提案及其可靠性分数在整个培训期间保持不变,并在随后更新时支持边界目标建设。

blocks.en: During inference, the trained detector directly predicts action categories, temporal boundaries, and confidence scores for an unseen video. PGI, CGR, point annotations, and the original candidate pool are used only during training.
blocks.zh: 在推论期间,训练有素的探测器直接预测动作类别,时间界限,和对一个看不见的视频的信心分数. PGI,CGR,点评说明,以及原候选人才库仅在训练期间使用.

blocks.en: We evaluate our method on four benchmark datasets. For fair comparison, we use the point annotations provided by HR-Pro [ 48 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们用四个基准数据集来评估我们的方法。 为了进行公平的比较,我们使用HR-Pro[48] 提供的要点说明。

blocks.en: • THUMOS14 [ 12 ] contains 413 untrimmed videos spanning 20 action categories. We use 200 videos for training and the remaining 213 for testing. • ActivityNet1.3 [ 2 ] comprises 10,024 training, 4,926 validation, and 5,044 test videos. Following the standard protocol [ 48 , 6 ] , we train on the training split and evaluate on the validation split. • GTEA [ 9 ] consists of 28 videos depicting seven fine-grained daily activities in a kitchen, with approximately 1,800 frames per video. • BEOID [ 4 ] contains 58 videos covering 30 action categories, with an average of 12.5 action instances per video. We follow the training and testing split used in [ 31 ] .

blocks.en: In Table 1 , we compare our framework with state-of-the-art methods under different levels of supervision on THUMOS14. Among the compared point-supervised methods, our framework achieves the highest average mAP over all three threshold ranges, reaching 68.5% over tIoU thresholds 0.1–0.7 and surpassing PseR by 3.7 percentage points. It also achieves 78.2% and 61.8% average mAP over 0.1–0.5 and 0.3–0.7, respectively. At the stricter tIoU thresholds of 0.5 and 0.7, our method improves over PseR by 5.4 and 5.9 percentage points, indicating stronger temporal localization performance.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,我们在THUMOS14的不同监督级别下,将我们的框架与最新方法进行比较。 在比较的点监督方法中,我们的框架在所有三个阈值范围内实现了最高的平均mAP,在tIoU阈值上达到68.5%,超过0.1–0.7,超过PseR3.7个百分点. 此外,在0.1-0.5和0.3-0.7之间,平均总产量分别达到78.2%和61.8%。 在更严格的tIoU阈值为0.5和0.7时,我们的方法比PseR提高了5.4和5.9个百分点,表明时间定位性能更强.

At tIoU 0.75, it obtains 30.7% mAP, improving over PseR by 1.1 percentage points. These results show that proposal-guided pseudo-label learning also improves overall detection performance on ActivityNet1.3.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 3 , our method achieves 62.2% average mAP over tIoU thresholds 0.1–0.7, surpassing TRA and PseR by 8.1 and 9.9 percentage points, respectively. It also achieves the highest mAP at every reported threshold. At tIoU 0.5, our method obtains 57.9% mAP, compared with TRA’s 47.2%, demonstrating stronger localization performance on this fine-grained action benchmark.

All configurations use HR-Pro as the proposal generator and ActionFormer as the detector. We compare a baseline trained directly with HR-Pro proposals, a variant using PGI initialization with fixed pseudo-labels, and the full framework incorporating CGR.

blocks.en: We examine the effects of the geometric and conflict priors on initial pseudo-label quality on THUMOS14. We retain the confidence prior in all variants and selectively enable the two point-derived priors, keeping the candidate pool fixed and evaluating labels before CGR refinement. Ground-truth boundaries are used only for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们在THUMOS14上审查了几何和冲突前缀对初始伪标签质量的影响。 我们保留对所有变种的置信度,并有选择地使两个积分前的积分得以计算,使候选人库保持固定,并在改进中央资源资源框架之前评价标签。 地面实况界限仅用于评价。

blocks.en: Table 6 : Ablation of PGI priors on THUMOS14. Initial pseudo-label quality is measured by mean tIoU and the fraction of labels with tIoU ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7 .
blocks.zh: 表6:THUMOS14上的PGI前科。 初始伪标签质量用平均值 tIoU 和带有 tIoU = 0.7\geq 0.7 的标签的分数来衡量.

blocks.en: Table 6 shows that both point-derived priors improve pseudo-label quality over confidence-only selection. The geometric prior increases mean tIoU from 0.571 to 0.601 and the fraction of labels with tIoU ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7 from 39.9% to 50.9%. The conflict prior yields a larger improvement in mean tIoU, reaching 0.651, while the geometric prior produces a higher fraction of well-localized labels. Combining both priors achieves the best results on both metrics, with a mean tIoU of 0.678 and a high-quality label fraction of 55.1%. These results support their complementary roles in identifying reliable initial pseudo-labels.
blocks.zh: 表6显示,两个点产生的前科都改进了伪标签的质量,而不是只选择信任。 几何前的TIOU从0.571增加到0.601,带有tIOU的标签从0.7\geq 0.7从39.9%增加到50.9%。 冲突之前,平均tIoU的改善幅度更大,达到0.651,而几何前,则产生较高比例的本地化标签。 将两个前科合并,在两个度量衡上都取得了最佳结果,平均tIoU为0.678,高质量标签分数为55.1%. 这些结果支持了它们在确定可靠的初始假标签方面的互补作用。

blocks.en: On THUMOS14, we assess CGR by comparing fixed PGI labels, detector-only updates using detector predictions alone, and full CGR, all with the same PGI initialization and ActionFormer detector. As shown in Figure 4 , CGR better preserves initialization quality during the middle of training and improves both quality metrics in later updates. At the final update, CGR reaches a mean pseudo-label tIoU of 0.708, with 62.4% of labels achieving tIoU ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7 . Compared with fixed PGI labels, CGR improves mean tIoU by 0.030 and the high-quality label fraction by 7.3 percentage points. Compared with detector-only updates, it improves mean tIoU by 0.017 and the high-quality label fraction by 3.9 percentage points. These results demonstrate that combining retained proposal evidence with detector predictions improves pseudo-label quality during training.
blocks.zh: 在THUMOS14上,我们通过比较固定的PGI标签,仅使用探测器预测的检测器更新,以及完全的CGR来评估CGR,它们都使用相同的PGI初始化和ActionFormer检测器. 如图4所示,CGR在培训中期更好地保持初始化质量,并在以后更新中改进两个质量衡量标准。 在最后更新时,CGR达到了0.708的平均伪标签tIoU,62.4%的标签实现了tIoU ~ 0.7\ geq 0.7 (英语). 与固定的PGI标签相比,CGR改进了平均值tIoU0.030,高质量的标签分数则提高了7.3个百分点. 与仅检测器的更新相比,它提高了0.017的平均值tIoU,高质量标签分数提高了3.9个百分点. 这些结果表明,将保留的提案证据与探测器预测相结合,提高了培训期间的伪标签质量。

blocks.en: We further examine the role of consistency control in CGR on THUMOS14. With the same PGI initialization, proposal consensus, fusion parameters, and update epochs, we compare three settings: no consistency constraint ( τ con k = 0 \tau_{\mathrm{con}}^{k}=0 ), a fixed threshold ( τ con k = 0.5 \tau_{\mathrm{con}}^{k}=0.5 ), and the progressive schedule that decreases the threshold from 1 to 0. Detection performance is measured at the final training epoch, and pseudo-label quality is evaluated against official ground truth after the final update.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查了在THUMOS14中心的一致性控制的作用。 有了相同的PGI初始化,建议共识,聚变参数,以及更新时代,我们比较了三个设置:没有一致性约束(\ con k = 0\ tau_{\mathrm{con}}^{k}=0),固定阈值(\ con k = 0.5\ tau_{\mathrm{con}}^{k}=0.5),以及将阈值从1降至0的渐进调度. 检测性能在最终训练时代进行测量,在最终更新后,根据官方地面真相评价伪标签质量.

blocks.en: Table 7 : Ablation of consistency control in CGR on THUMOS14. AVG mAP (%) is computed over tIoU thresholds 0.1–0.7. Pseudo-label quality is evaluated against official ground truth at the final update.
blocks.zh: 表7:在THUMOS14上的中央研究院一致性控制系数。 在最后更新时,根据官方的地面真相对Pseudo-label质量进行评估。

blocks.en: Table 7 shows that progressive consistency control achieves 68.5% average mAP, outperforming unconstrained updates and the fixed threshold by 4.2 and 1.1 percentage points, respectively. It also yields the highest mean pseudo-label tIoU of 0.708 and a high-quality label fraction of 62.4%, exceeding the fixed-threshold variant by 4.0 percentage points on the latter metric. These results support strict agreement early in refinement followed by gradual relaxation, which improves both temporal supervision and detection performance.
blocks.zh: 表7显示,渐进式一致性控制达到68.5%的平均mAP,表现优于不受约束的更新和固定阈值,分别为4.2和1.1个百分点. 它还产生0.708的最高平均假标签tIoU和62.4%的高质量标签分数,在后一计量标准上超过固定阈值变量4.0个百分点。 这些结果支持在完善初期就严格达成一致,然后逐步放松,这既改善了时间监督和检测工作。

blocks.en: On THUMOS14, we compare detector-only refinement, refinement guided by the initial PGI boundary ( K = 1 K=1 ), and full CGR with proposal consensus ( K = 10 K=10 ), using the same PGI initialization. Detector-only uses detector predictions alone; the other two variants introduce original boundary evidence from a single initial pseudo-label or multiple retained candidates, respectively. Table 8 shows that incorporating original boundary evidence improves both detection performance and pseudo-label quality over detector-only refinement. Full CGR achieves 68.5% average mAP, compared with 67.4% for detector-only refinement, while increasing mean pseudo-label tIoU from 0.691 to 0.708 and the fraction of labels with tIoU ≥ 0.7 \geq 0.7 from 58.5% to 62.4%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of retained proposal evidence in guiding pseudo-label refinement.
blocks.zh: 在THUMOS14上,我们用相同的PGI初始边界(K = 1 K = 1)来比较检测器唯一精度的精度,用建议共识(K = 10 K = 10)来比较全CGR的精度. 探测器只使用探测器预测;另外两种变体分别从单个初始伪标签或多个保留候选物引入原始边界证据. 表8显示,纳入原始边界证据比仅用于探测器的改进既能提高探测性能,又能提高伪标签质量。 完整的CGR实现68.5%的平均mAP,而仅用于检测器的精度为67.4%,同时将平均伪标签tIoU从0.691增加到0.708,并将带有tIoU的标签的一小部分 0.7\geq 0.7从58.5%增加到62.4%。 这些结果表明,保留的提案证据在指导改进伪标签方面是有效的。

blocks.en: We vary the consensus fusion threshold τ iou ∈ { 0.1 , 0.3 , 0.5 , 0.7 } \tau_{\mathrm{iou}}\in\{0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7\} on THUMOS14 and ActivityNet1.3, keeping the PGI initialization and all other refinement settings fixed within each dataset. This threshold controls whether proposal consensus is fused with the detector prediction. Table 9 shows that thresholds of 0.3 and 0.5 yield comparable AVG mAP on both datasets, reaching 68.5% on THUMOS14 and 30.9% on ActivityNet1.3. The default threshold of 0.5 also achieves 35.5% mAP@0.7 on THUMOS14 and the highest mAP@0.95 of 7.2% on ActivityNet1.3 among the tested settings. Increasing the threshold to 0.7 reduces both average and strict-tIoU detection performance on the two datasets. These results support 0.5 as a shared default for consensus fusion.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented a framework for learning high-quality pseudo-labels in point-supervised temporal action localization through prior-guided initialization and consensus-guided refinement. Our central idea is to reuse original proposals as boundary evidence for both supervision initialization and subsequent refinement. PGI combines proposal confidence with point-derived geometric and conflict priors to select reliable initial pseudo-labels and retain alternative candidates. CGR integrates consensus from these candidates with evolving detector predictions to refine supervision through consistency-controlled updates. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate improved detection performance, while ablations and pseudo-label analyses validate the effectiveness of both modules. The framework is also effective with different proposal generators and detector architectures. These findings highlight the value of retaining and reusing original proposal evidence throughout pseudo-label learning.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个框架,通过事先指导的初始化和协商一致指导的完善,在点监督的时间行动定位中学习高质量的伪标签。 我们的中心思想是重新利用原始建议作为监督初始化和随后改进的边界证据。 PGI将建议置信度与点位几何和冲突前缀相结合,以选择可靠的初始伪标签并保留替代候选人. CGR将来自这些候选人的共识与不断发展的探测器预测结合起来,通过一致性控制的更新来完善监督. 对四项基准的试验表明检测性能有所改善,而模拟和伪标签分析则验证了这两个模块的有效性。 该框架还具有不同的提议发电机和探测器架构。 这些结论突出了在整个伪标签学习过程中保留和重新使用原始提案证据的价值。
